info.name: GraphQL Message Board API
info.description: Every query and mutation with happy and sad paths (inputs, outputs, error codes and messages). Run top to bottom against a running backend; ids are captured in environment variables and everything created is deleted at the end. Subscriptions are covered by the back-end e2e, integration and Playwright suites (Newman has no WebSocket support).

request.description: Also sets a unique runId so the collection can be re-run.
